'# Následující kód pro vytvoření datového rámce a odeberání duplicitních řádků je spuštěn vždy a funguje jako preambule pro váš skript:

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

dataset["measured_value"] = pd.to_numeric(dataset["measured_value"], errors="coerce")
dataset["limit_min"] = pd.to_numeric(dataset["limit_min"], errors="coerce")
dataset["limit_max"] = pd.to_numeric(dataset["limit_max"], errors="coerce")

data = dataset["measured_value"].dropna()
lsl  = dataset["limit_min"].dropna().median()
usl  = dataset["limit_max"].dropna().median()
mean = data.mean()
std  = data.std()

# Cp výpočty
cp  = round((usl - lsl) / (6 * std), 2) if std > 0 else None
cpu = round((usl - mean) / (3 * std), 2) if std > 0 else None
cpl = round((mean - lsl) / (3 * std), 2) if std > 0 else None

# Titulek
test  = dataset["test_num"].iloc[0]
desc  = dataset["test_description"].iloc[0]
group = dataset["product_group"].iloc[0]
pid   = dataset["product_id"].iloc[0]
title = f"{test} - {desc}; {group}; product_id: {pid}"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 4))
fig.subplots_adjust(right=0.82)

ax.set_title(title, fontsize=9)
ax.hist(data, bins="auto", color="#0072C6", edgecolor="white", alpha=0.9)
ax.axvline(lsl,  color="red",    linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, label=f"LSL: {lsl:.3f}")
ax.axvline(usl,  color="red",    linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, label=f"USL: {usl:.3f}")
ax.axvline(mean, color="red",  linestyle="-",  linewidth=1.2, label=f"Mean: {mean:.3f}")
ax.axvline(mean - 3*std, color="orange", linestyle=":", linewidth=1, label=f"-3σ: {mean-3*std:.3f}")
ax.axvline(mean + 3*std, color="orange", linestyle=":", linewidth=1, label=f"+3σ: {mean+3*std:.3f}")

# Cp hodnoty vpravo
cp_text = f"cp:   {cp}\ncpU:  {cpu}\ncpL:  {cpl}"
ax.text(1.02, 0.5, cp_text, transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=10, verticalalignment="center", family="monospace")

ax.set_xlabel("Measured value")
ax.set_ylabel("Count")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 1.0), loc="upper left")
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)

plt.show()'
